title: Statement by Hon Margaret Wilson on the death of Trevor de Cleene
content:
23 April 2001

Statement by Hon Margaret Wilson on the death of Trevor de Cleene

  • Margaret Wilson
Attorney-General

"I feel very sad to learn of the death of Trevor de Cleene. Although not unexpected, his death will still be a shock to the family, to whom I extend my sympathy.

"Trevor led a full life, and will be remembered as one of the great New Zealand characters".
